svg.aria-label: The thirty-six named generations from Adam and Eve to Rashed
svg.text: thirty-six named generations — adam & eve to rāshid
Researched and compiled by John Aziz Mogannam. Each band is coloured by what holds that stretch of the chain.
Rashed bin Essaye bin Eyad bin Dhahdou…
Al-Ghassānī — the tribal name that survives in the family’s own subtitle — enters at generation 29, with ‘Amr Muzayqiyāʾ.

Generation 35 is the void: one line standing for nine hundred years and, by the chart’s own count, forty-five generations. This book counts it as thirty-one, which makes the line sixty-six generations, not thirty-six.
